steps.stepText_en: Let’s start with plant management. Click the toggle to switch to “Plant Mode”
Plants can burn up to 3x their height, which is especially dangerous when they are near your home.
Tap to remove the dead bushes in the critical zone.
Home hardening is a process that makes your home more resistant to wildfires. Upgrading roofing, walls, eaves, and other areas can protect embers from catching fire.
When your budget dips lower, you may see the chance to earn more money by answering a quiz question. Try clicking on the money bag icon.
Talk to your neighbor (Player 2) to make sure both houses are safe from fire danger.
